note: Rotation pool for the homepage Question when data/today.json is more than two days old. Each entry is {id, src}. src 'archive' means a question we REALLY asked, in data/archive/ and listed on archive.html; src 'bank' means one written for this rotation that has never run, in data/qbank/ and deliberately NOT in the archive, because archive.html promises 'every question we have ever asked'. The homepage labels the two differently. Rotates one per calendar day from `anchor`; plain-string entries are still read as archive dates. When the daily pipeline resumes, today.json goes fresh and this file is not consulted.
